data.narrative:
Cradle, a Series B biotech company founded by van Grieken, de Reus, Prins, Bixby, and van Rossum, has raised $102.7M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 8 private-stage biotech and health companies plus 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-progression anchors on the $102.7M raised as a proxy baseline, applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-later-stage step-ups, yielding $195M. Peer-median triangulation uses four same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables: Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B), New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), and Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C). The median across this peer set is $3.5B, with a range of $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable; while the Biotech & Health sector shows a 6.6x median P/S across three public tickers, Cradle's revenue is not disclosed.

The triangulated analysis across two methods supports a valuation range of $166M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around whether Cradle's commercial trajectory and near-term financing trajectory track the lower end (Eikon comparables) or the higher end (Series C-stage peers). Stage and revenue visibility are the primary variables that would narrow this band.
